title: synthetic-data-generator
summary: A web application with a FastAPI backend that lets users upload tabular data and generate synthetic versions using configurable synthesizers, with quality and diagnostic evaluation. It directly imports and runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer, along with SingleTableMetadata and evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic, to power its core synthesis and evaluation features.
